description: Cross-class hunt over the tenzir OCSF archive (s3://tenzir/ocsf/, class_uid hive partitions) through the tenzir-ocsf DuckDB datasource and its lazy `ocsf` view. Panels are empty until the archive parquet flows (the 15-minute node windows archive every 5 minutes). Class panels filter with class_uid: API Activity 6003 (k8s audit), Authentication 3002 / Account Change 3001 (authentik), Detection Finding 2004 (sigma + trivy secrets), Vulnerability Finding 2002 (trivy), Network Activity 4001 (netflow + tetragon), Process Activity 1007 / File System Activity 1001 (tetragon).

panels.description: Events per bucket for every archived class: API Activity 6003, Authentication 3002, Account Change 3001, Detection Finding 2004, Vulnerability Finding 2002, Network Activity 4001, Process Activity 1007, File System Activity 1001. The archive is the s3://tenzir/ocsf/ class-partitioned parquet read through the tenzir-ocsf datasource view.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time,
  class_uid::VARCHAR AS metric,
  count(*) AS events
FROM ocsf
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Event rate by class_uid

panels.description: severity_id captions across all classes in the window (OCSF: 0 Unknown, 1 Informational, 2 Low, 3 Medium, 4 High, 5 Critical, 6 Fatal). k8s-audit 6003 rows carry no severity; they fall into 0 Unknown.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE severity_id
         WHEN 0 THEN '0 Unknown'
         WHEN 1 THEN '1 Informational'
         WHEN 2 THEN '2 Low'
         WHEN 3 THEN '3 Medium'
         WHEN 4 THEN '4 High'
         WHEN 5 THEN '5 Critical'
         WHEN 6 THEN '6 Fatal'
         ELSE '99 Other'
       END AS severity,
       count(*) AS events
FROM ocsf
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Severity distribution

panels.description: Total events per class_uid in the window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT class_uid::VARCHAR AS class,
       count(*) AS events
FROM ocsf
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Event volume by class_uid

panels.description: Most active kube-apiserver callers in the window (class_uid 6003).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT actor.user.name AS actor,
       count(*) AS calls
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 6003
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: API Activity: top actors (user.name)

panels.description: Most frequent api.operation values in the window (class_uid 6003).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT api.operation AS operation,
       count(*) AS calls
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 6003
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: API Activity: top operations (api.operation)

panels.description: Kubernetes resources touched most in the window (unmapped.object_ref from the k8s audit mapper; class_uid 6003).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT unmapped.object_ref.resource AS resource,
       unmapped.object_ref.namespace AS namespace,
       count(*) AS calls
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 6003
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: API Activity: top resources

panels.description: Authentication (3002) events split by status_id caption (1 Success, 2 Failure).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time,
  CASE status_id WHEN 1 THEN 'success' WHEN 2 THEN 'failure' ELSE 'unknown' END AS status,
  count(*) AS logins
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 3002
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Authentik: logins by status

panels.description: Account Change (3001) events in the window: action, actor, source IP.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time,
       unmapped.action AS action,
       actor.user.name AS actor,
       src_endpoint.ip AS source_ip
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 3001
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Authentik: account changes

panels.description: Process Activity (1007) events split by activity (1 Launch, 2 Terminate, other = container-escape namespace access).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time,
  CASE activity_id WHEN 1 THEN 'launch' WHEN 2 THEN 'terminate' ELSE 'other' END AS activity,
  count(*) AS events
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 1007
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tetragon: process activity

panels.description: Most launched process binaries in the window (1007, activity_id = 1).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT process.path AS binary,
       count(*) AS launches
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 1007
  AND activity_id = 1
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Tetragon: top launched binaries

panels.description: File System Activity (1001) hits from the secret-file-access kprobe: file, permission, actor, pod, node.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time,
       file.path AS file,
       file.xattributes.permission AS permission,
       actor.process.path AS actor_binary,
       actor.process.container.name AS actor_container,
       unmapped.pod.name AS pod,
       unmapped.pod.namespace AS pod_namespace,
       device.hostname AS node
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 1001
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Tetragon: secret-file-access

panels.description: NetFlow (4001, traffic data) and tetragon kprobe connect attempts (4001, policy_name set) by destination.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT dst_endpoint.ip AS destination,
       CASE WHEN unmapped.policy_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'tetragon' ELSE 'netflow' END AS source,
       count(*) AS flows,
       sum(traffic.bytes) AS bytes
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 4001
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Network Activity: top destinations

panels.description: Bytes per bucket for netflow Network Activity (4001) rows (traffic is netflow-only).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time,
  sum(traffic.bytes) AS bytes
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 4001
  AND traffic IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: NetFlow: traffic volume

panels.description: Vulnerability Finding (2002) CVEs in the window (unnested from vulnerabilities[]): CVE, severity, package, fix, workload.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT u.cve.uid AS cve,
       u.severity AS severity,
       u.title AS description,
       u.affected_packages[1].name AS package,
       u.affected_packages[1].fixed_in_version AS fixed_in,
       unmapped.workload.namespace || '/' || unmapped.workload.name AS workload,
       time AS seen
FROM ocsf
CROSS JOIN unnest(vulnerabilities) AS t(u)
WHERE class_uid = 2002
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY seen DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Trivy: latest CVEs

panels.description: Latest trivy VulnerabilityReport state per workload (2002, update-shaped rescans): severity and summary counts.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time AS last_scan,
       unmapped.workload.kind || '/' || unmapped.workload.namespace || '/' || unmapped.workload.name AS workload,
       unmapped.workload.container AS container,
       severity_id,
       unmapped.summary.criticalCount AS critical,
       unmapped.summary.highCount AS high,
       unmapped.summary.mediumCount AS medium,
       unmapped.summary.lowCount AS low
FROM ocsf
WHERE class_uid = 2002
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Trivy: workload scan summary
